name: proyecto-tareas
description: API de tareas (Express + MongoDB) y su frontend Gestor de tareas (Vue 3 + PWA)

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix api-tareas && npm install --prefix gestor-tareas
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix api-tareas" "npm run dev --prefix gestor-tareas"
scripts.preview: npm run build --prefix gestor-tareas && concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm start --prefix api-tareas" "npm run preview --prefix gestor-tareas"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix gestor-tareas && npm test --prefix api-tareas
